query: SELECT ventureId, title, hypothesis, result FROM experiments ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 12;
command: mysql --batch --raw --column-names --default-character-set=utf8mb4 --host gateway04.us-east-1.prod.aws.tidbcloud.com --port 4000 --user 3HthdpivREJ9B8M.root --database ggmroLG8ezURUZiLzGveTG --execute SELECT ventureId, title, hypothesis, result FROM experiments ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 12;

rows.title: Bio-polymer blend tensile strength test
rows.hypothesis: EcoBlend formulation X-7 achieves ≥85% tensile strength of virgin plastic at 30% lower cost
rows.result: Formulation X-7 achieved 91% tensile strength at 28% lower material cost

rows.title: Retail packaging customer acceptance trial
rows.hypothesis: Eco-packaging increases purchase intent by ≥15% among target demographic
rows.result: Purchase intent increased 22% with eco-packaging; price sensitivity decreased

rows.title: Industrial compostability certification test
rows.hypothesis: EcoBlend material meets EN 13432 industrial compostability standard
rows.result: 87% mass loss at 60 days; EN 13432 threshold is 90% — narrowly failed

rows.title: Mycelium composite structural integrity
rows.hypothesis: Mycelium-hemp composite achieves 40 MPa compressive strength
rows.result: Average 44.2 MPa compressive strength achieved across all samples

rows.title: Algae-based bioplastic UV degradation rate
rows.hypothesis: Algae bioplastic degrades 60% faster than PLA under UV exposure
rows.result: 68% faster degradation confirmed; colour stability also superior to PLA

rows.title: Scale-up fermentation yield consistency
rows.hypothesis: Pilot fermentation batch (500L) achieves ≥90% yield consistency vs lab (5L)
rows.result: Yield consistency 78% — below target; temperature gradient identified as cause

rows.title: Electric cargo bike range under load
rows.hypothesis: BEBUS cargo bike achieves 60km range at 80kg payload in urban conditions
rows.result: Average 67km range achieved; battery thermal management performing above spec

rows.title: Fleet operator pricing model validation
rows.hypothesis: Fleet operators will commit to ≥5 unit trial at £3,200/unit/year lease
rows.result: 7/10 expressed strong interest; 2 signed LOIs at £3,400/unit/year

rows.title: Regenerative braking efficiency in hilly terrain
rows.hypothesis: Regenerative braking recovers ≥15% of energy on Bristol's gradient profile
rows.result: 12.3% energy recovery — below 15% target on steepest routes

rows.title: Eco-creative brief client conversion rate
rows.hypothesis: TONE's sustainability-first creative brief increases client conversion by 20%
rows.result: 28% higher conversion rate; average project value also 15% higher

rows.title: Carbon-neutral print production feasibility
rows.hypothesis: Carbon-neutral print production is achievable at <10% cost premium
rows.result: 8.2% average cost premium confirmed; 3 supplier partnerships established

rows.title: Bio-foam impact absorption vs EPS benchmark
rows.hypothesis: REAL bio-foam achieves ≥95% impact absorption of EPS at equal density
rows.result: 97.4% impact absorption achieved; weight 8% lighter than EPS equivalent
